content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an unusual issue with my [product_name] [version_no]. The data logging feature stops on its own after running for a period of time. Could anyone provide assistance? Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: A user has encountered an issue where data logging on their [product_name] [version_no] is interrupted unexpectedly after some time. This affects the ability to reliably monitor and analyze data, as logging does not continue without interruption. There are no error messages or clear reasons for the stoppage mentioned, and the problem remains unresolved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the data logging feature on the [product_name] [version_no] to work continuously without unexpected interruptions or needing manual restarts.
